system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Helen Stoner, a pale young woman in a plain high-necked dark dress, seated and leaning forward in a London sitting-room","action":"She speaks earnestly with her hands clasped, glancing aside while Holmes in a dressing-gown listens attentively and Watson stands nearby","setting":"221B Baker Street sitting-room, cluttered with papers and books, a gaslit lamp glowing against grey window light","secondaryElements":"Holmes's armchair and pipe rack, a coal fire low in the grate, Watson's chair by the table, rain-streaked windows showing London rooftops","mood":"Restrained, intimate unease with dry gaslit tension and a hint of gothic dread","timeOfDay":"Overcast afternoon indoors with lamplight","composition":"Medium interior shot, Helen at left in three-quarter view facing Holmes at right, Watson in background between them"}
